content: Dapagliflozin has been shown to be effective in reducing the risk of hospitalization due to heart failure in patients with both preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) and reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), as demonstrated in the DELIVER trial. Furthermore, dapagliflozin was found to enhance functional capacity and alleviate symptoms in these patients. This makes it a valuable therapeutic option for managing heart failure across different ejection fraction categories.
